# Source: Meetinghouse Hill, Roxbury, Massachusetts

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Meetinghouse Hill, Roxbury, Massachusetts
- **Artist / culture:** John Ritto Penniman (American, c. 1782–1841)
- **Date:** 1799
- **Style:** Folk Art
- **Classification:** painting
- **Department:** Arts of the Americas
- **AIC artwork ID:** 59455
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/59455
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/498e45a7-5721-25dd-e26c-09b3e5b8010b/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Folk Art

## Extracted source palette

`#384838, #A8C8C8, #183838, #585848, #C8D8D8, #78A8B8, #889898, #887858`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#0C1D1D`
- `surface`: `#283737`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#78A8B8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#183838`
- `surface_variant`: `#283737`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#4E5A5A`
- `error`: `#78A8B8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `comic-neue` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `16.33:1`, surface `11.67:1`
- Variant contrast: `11.67:1`
- Control contrast: `7.53:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
